title: Explain and defend a technical trade-off
summary: Recommend an engineering option, make consequences audible and repair an unclear explanation.

sections.title: Decision context
sections.content: Synchronous validation gives an immediate answer but adds up to 900 ms at peak. A queued worker keeps requests fast and retries transient failures, but final status may take two minutes. The release needs predictable request latency; compliance requires validation before publication.

exercises.question: Which requirement favors the queued worker?
exercises.explanation: The queue moves validation latency out of the request path.

performanceTask.title: Recommend and defend one design
performanceTask.scenario: Explain an architecture recommendation to engineers and a product manager.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Use the decision evidence shown here. State the constraint, recommendation, cost and mitigation before support appears.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: In 60–90 seconds, frame the decision, recommend one option, connect the benefit and cost to constraints, then mitigate the main risk.
performanceTask.modelResponse: I recommend the queued worker because predictable request latency is the release constraint. It also gives us retries for transient failures. The cost is delayed final status, which may take two minutes. We can mitigate that by showing a pending state and blocking publication until validation succeeds.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Use the retry context. Lead with one recommendation and connect each consequence to a named constraint.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Use the database context and make a new recommendation without model/chunks.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Use the build-versus-buy context and explain a fresh decision without model/chunks.

baseline.title: Validation architecture

artifacts.title: Latency and compliance
artifacts.content: Sync: immediate status, +900 ms peak. Queue: fast request, retries, up to two-minute result. Constraint: predictable latency and validation before publication.

artifacts.title: Processing options
artifacts.content: Inline resize: immediate image, +1.4 s request time. Background resize: 120 ms request, up to 30 s pending. Constraint: mobile upload reliability; preview may be delayed.

transfer.title: Database ownership
transfer.brief: Unseen transfer for a two-person team.

artifacts.title: Managed versus self-hosted
artifacts.content: Managed database costs $900/month and includes backups/on-call support. Self-hosted costs $250/month but needs about 12 engineer-hours/month. Constraint: two-person team and 24/7 recovery.

artifacts.title: Authentication options
artifacts.content: Vendor: four-week integration, recurring fee, compliance reports included. Build: twelve weeks, full control, team owns audits. Constraint: launch in six weeks.

audio.text: The request stays fast, but the result is delayed.
I recommend the queued worker because latency is the constraint.
It retries failures; however, users wait for final status.
We can mitigate the delay with a pending state.

audio.text: For this release, I would choose the queue.
If the product needs immediate status, we can revisit the decision.
